description: This file contains Kotlin code implementing a handler for Android call log operations, including reading permissions, searching call logs with filters, and returning results as JSON. It defines data models, a data source interface, a system implementation, and a handler class with parsing and JSON conversion logic.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a call log entry with number, cached name, date, duration, and type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search parameters for call log queries.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission check and search in call logs.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing CallLogDataSource using Android's CallLog content provider.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class handling call log search requests, permission validation, parsing JSON input, and returning JSON results.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Handles the call log search request by verifying permissions, parsing input JSON, querying data, and formatting the output.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into CallLogSearchRequest object with proper defaulting and validation.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts CallLogRecord object to JSON format.
